title: The creator of Roomba is back with a furry robot companion
raw_excerpt: The first “Familiar” from Colin Angle’s new startup, Familiar Machines & Magic, is a robot that is designed to live in your home and interact autonomously with family members. | Image: Familiar Machines and Magic Colin Angle, the maker of the Roomba and the man who helped put 50 million household robots into people's homes, is back with a new robot. But this one is designed as a companion, not a cleaner. The first robot from Angle's new company, Familiar Machines & Magic , is a dog-sized robotic pet that resembles a cross between a bear, a barn owl, and a golden retriever. It has an expressive face, with movable eyebrows, ears, and eyes, and the company calls it a "Familiar," a name meant to evoke folklore around the idea of a supernatural companion. Based on a demo video I saw ahead of its appearance at the WSJ Future of Everything conference this w … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Roomba 创造者 Colin Angle 的新公司 Familiar Machines & Magic 推出了一款狗大小的机器人宠物，外形介于熊、仓鸮和金毛之间，旨在作为家庭伴侣而非清洁工具。该机器人具有表情丰富的眼睛和耳朵，可自主与家人互动。这标志着家用机器人从功能性工具向情感陪伴方向的重大转变，可能开启新的消费机器人品类。

title: 豆包将在免费模式外新增付费订阅，推出三档月包/年包价格｜最前线
raw_excerpt: 近日，豆包App Store页面出现付费版本服务声明。声明称，为更好地服务专业用户，豆包将在免费版的基础上，推出包含更多增值服务的付费版本。同时，该页面还披露了三档订阅价格：标准版连续包月每月68元（连续包年688元）、加强版连续包月每月200元（连续包年2048元）、专业版连续包月每月500元（连续包年5088元）。 豆包 目前，尚未在豆包产品中看到相关的付费选项和功能。豆包官方回应称，“豆包始终提供免费服务，在免费服务的基础上，豆包也在探索推出更多增值服务，以满足不同用户的差异化需求。相关方案细节目前还在测试阶段，正式上线时会通过官方渠道发布完整信息。” 据接近豆包的人士透露，付费功能将主要专注在复杂任务和生产力场景，如PPT生成、数据分析、影视制作等。随着模型能力持续升级，产品已经能满足越来越多的复杂高价值任务。但此类任务需消耗更多算力与推理时间，因此豆包计划上线付费服务，满足好这部分复杂场景需求。免费版本则继续面向用户的日常使用。
summary: 字节跳动旗下豆包在 App Store 页面披露付费版本计划，推出标准版（68元/月）、加强版（200元/月）和专业版（500元/月）三档订阅。付费功能将聚焦 PPT 生成、数据分析、影视制作等复杂生产力场景，免费版继续服务日常使用。这是国内头部 AI 助手从免费模式向分层订阅转型的重要信号，反映了模型能力提升后对高价值场景的商业化探索。

title: “DeepSeek版Claude Code”，Github 2.3k星

title: Anthropic tests Jupiter-v1-p ahead of its developer conference
raw_excerpt: Anthropic appears to have started a fresh round of red teaming on a new internal build. The company is set to host its Code with Claude developer conference in San Francisco on May 6. The timing suggests that the model is being hardened ahead of an announcement timed to the event. The red team round is consistent with the company's responsible scaling policy, which calls for jailbreak probes and constitutional classifier stress tests before any frontier-class deployment.
summary: Anthropic 正在对内部新模型 Jupiter-v1-p 进行新一轮红队测试，时间点恰好在 5 月 6 日旧金山“Code with Claude”开发者大会之前。这表明 Anthropic 可能在大会上发布重大更新，且遵循其负责任扩展政策，在部署前沿模型前进行严格的越狱和分类器压力测试。

title: Google is testing new Omni model for video generation
raw_excerpt: Google is testing a new Omni model for video generation, potentially unifying its video and image-generation tools. The Omni model appears in Gemini's video generation UI, suggesting it might become a public product name. A launch during Google I/O 2026 is possible amidst increasing AI video competition.
summary: Google 正在测试一款新的 Omni 视频生成模型，该模型出现在 Gemini 的视频生成 UI 中，可能统一其视频和图像生成工具。此举正值 AI 视频竞争加剧之际，预计可能在 Google I/O 2026 上正式发布，标志着 Google 在多模态生成领域的战略整合。

title: SpecKV: Adaptive Speculative Decoding with Compression-Aware Gamma Selection
raw_excerpt:
作者: Shikhar Shukla
摘要: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a small draft model to propose candidate tokens that a larger target model verifies. A critical hyperparameter in this process is the speculation length~$γ$, which determines how many tokens the draft model proposes per step. Nearly all existing systems use a fixed~$γ$ (typically~4), yet empirical evidence suggests that the optimal value varies across task types and, crucially, depends on the compression level applied to the target model. In this paper, we present \textbf{SpecKV}, a lightweight adaptive controller that selects~$γ$ per speculation step using signals extracted from the draft model itself. We profile speculative decoding across 4~task categories, 4~speculation lengths, and 3~compression levels (FP16, INT8, NF4), collecting 5,112 step-level records with per-step acceptance rates, draft entropy, and draft confidence. We demonstrate that the optimal~$γ$ shifts across compression regimes and that draft model confidence and entropy are strong predictors of acceptance rate (correlation~$\approx 0.56$). SpecKV uses a small MLP trained on these signals to maximize expected tokens per speculation step, achieving a 56.0\% improvement over the fixed-$γ$=4 baseline with only 0.34\,ms overhead per decision ($<$0.5\% of step time). The improvement is statistically significant ($p < 0.001$, paired bootstrap test). We release all profiling data, trained models, and notebooks a…
summary: 论文提出 SpecKV，一种轻量级方法用于自适应选择推测解码中的推测长度 γ。现有系统通常使用固定 γ（如 4），但最优值因任务和模型压缩程度而异。SpecKV 通过压缩感知的动态选择，可提升 LLM 推理效率，对降低部署成本有实际意义。

title: AutoRound (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: AutoRound is an advanced quantization toolkit designed for large language models and vision-language models. It achieves high accuracy at ultra-low bit widths with minimal tuning. AutoRound seamlessly works with Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and more. It can quantize 7B models in 10 minutes on a single GPU.
summary: Intel 开源了 AutoRound 量化工具包，专为大语言模型和视觉语言模型设计，可在超低位宽下实现高精度量化，且只需极少调优。该工具与 Transformers、vLLM、SGLang 等主流框架无缝集成，单 GPU 10 分钟即可量化 7B 模型，对模型部署效率提升显著。

title: MolmoAct2: Action Reasoning Models for Real-world Deployment
summary: MolmoAct2 是 Molmo 系列的新模型，专注于动作推理，旨在提升 AI 在真实世界部署中的决策能力。该论文来自艾伦人工智能研究所，展示了如何通过强化学习使视觉语言模型在复杂环境中执行多步操作，对机器人、自动驾驶等具身智能领域具有参考价值。

title: raullenchai/Rapid-MLX
raw_excerpt: The fastest local AI engine for Apple Silicon. 4.2x faster than Ollama, 0.08s cached TTFT, 100% tool calling. 17 tool parsers, prompt cache, reasoning separation, cloud routing. Drop-in OpenAI replacement. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Aider.
summary: Rapid-MLX 是专为 Apple Silicon 设计的本地 AI 引擎，宣称比 Ollama 快 4.2 倍，缓存 TTFT 仅 0.08 秒，支持 100% 工具调用。它兼容 OpenAI API，可与 Claude Code、Cursor、Aider 等工具配合使用，为 Mac 用户提供了高性能的本地推理方案。
